blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—National University squeaked past Far Eastern University, 69-65, to move into first place in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Sunday at Ateneo Blue Eagle Gym. The Bulldogs stretched their winning streak to three to improve to 5-2. NU shares the same record as University of the Philippines, but its win over UP last month puts the Bulldogs at No. 1. The Tamaraws, on the other hand, absorbed their second straight defeat after a hot 4-1 start to begin the tournament. READ: UAAP: ‘Win or lose,’ NU trusts Reinhard […]...
